query: I have some troublesome plants mixed among my maize
My maize leaves are changing colour and something keeps eating them
I need to know when during the day I should gather my vegetables
Aburo no mu nwura haw me paa
Me pɛ aduan ama m'aburo na mennim deɛ ɛfata
M'aburo nhaban sesa kɔla na biribi redi
